metadata.description: MCP server for war.app (Warzone) — your games, players, settings, map bonuses and chokepoints, board analysis and route planning through war.app's per-player GameFeed API, plus the live board, territory picks, cards, turn planning and submission, turn notifications and game chat through your signed-in war.app tab (joining or surrendering a game, Begin on a speed first turn, picks, turn orders, withdrawing them, chat sends and linking a session are confirm-gated).
